Two merged PRs on the main line, up to pinned head `5eb8cba` (`origin/master`), changed a `ThreadLocal` line under `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api`:

1. **PR #6544** (TRUNK-6799, "Introduce Spring Security with support for legacy authentication context"), merged **2026-10-08**, commit `a69b14a84bf925ff7cdf34e93ca1ffb4f257265f`. It removed the `ThreadLocal<Object[]>` holder and its comment, and added `ThreadLocal<UserContext>` plus a Javadoc line mentioning `{@link ThreadLocal}`. The current declaration is @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/context/Context.java:162-162}, and the added Javadoc line is @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/context/Context.java:237-237}.
2. **PR #6588** (TRUNK-6721, "Replace StackWalker with a thread-local guard in UserDAO"), merged **2026-09-21**, commit `f10e3fb9a645378ab6682c21d6be478bfdab6199`. It added `private static final ThreadLocal<Integer> DEPTH` inside the nested `UserPasswordGuard` class, @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/UserServiceImpl.java:111-111}.

Dates are the squash-commit dates, which are the merge dates here.

Commits checked and ruled out (no added or removed line containing `ThreadLocal`): #6349 (`b68355b`), #6672 (`0340ada`, which only moved the `log` field below `userContextHolder`), #6756 (`4d92b49`), #6713 follow-up (`265582`), #6348 (`41ec295`, for `Context.java` and `ServiceContext.java` only), #6233 (`c4aca3a`, for `Context.java` and `ServiceContext.java` only), #6383 (`1b5421a`) and #6627 (`2c9b2ee`), both for `RolePrivilegeCache.java`, and #6298 (`adec734`) was not examined. Also #6651 (`b64e0729`) and #6654 (`83411b2`, not fully diffed) showed no `Context.java` change for `b64e0729`.

Coverage is incomplete. I did not diff every one of the 43 commits since 2026-04-14. I checked the commits most likely to touch `ThreadLocal`, and some of those only for specific files. Some large diffs were saved to files I was not allowed to read, so for those I checked only the paths I could diff directly.
